messages.text:
Hello, 

 I purchased two lunch bags on Jan 14 ( order: L-45536). I have not yet received them and I am wondering if there has been a shipping error? 
 

 Thank you!

messages.subject: Return/Defect
messages.text:
Hello, 

 I recently purchased two lunch pails (order # L-45536 ). The black lunch pail appears to have a buckle defect wherein it does not stay clipped together. I have no issues with the green. 
 

 I would like to return and exchange for another black lunch pail that doesn't have such issues. 
 

 Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: Return/Defect
messages.text:
Hello Olivia,
 

 No problem for the return!
 

 We could send you another buckle to replace the one that doesn't clip; would that suit you or would you really prefer to exchange the lunch bag?
 

 Looking forward to your response.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
